fr_html: M. Loder ne peut pas adopter l'article proposé par Lord Phillimore. Cet article prend comme point de départ l'article 13 du Pacte, dans lequel il n'est point question de la Cour Permanente de Justice.
en_html: M. Loder could not accept the Article, proposed by Lord Phillimore. This article took as its starting point Article 13 of the Covenant in which there was no question whatever of the Permanent Court of International Justice.
